title: 각종분쟁조정위원회등의조정조서등에대한집행문부여에관한규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Applications)
(1) In order to enforce a claim against the opposing party, a creditor named in a record may apply to the competent district court for a writ of execution by submitting the authentic copy of the record (meaning the document served on or delivered to the creditor by the mediation committee as having the same effect as a judicial settlement; hereinafter the same shall apply).
(2) An application under paragraph (1) shall be made in writing with a revenue stamp affixed as prescribed by the main sentence of Article 10 of the Act on the Stamps Attached to Civil Litigation, etc., and the applicant shall pay in advance the expenses necessary for commissioning delivery and notifying the grant of a writ of execution under Articles 6 and 7.
